ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution (~82% of surface) with high-intensity (white) clusters (~18%) forming distinct high-contrast patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity linear parallel bands clustered on the outer third of the left lobe; single prominent diagonal high-intensity band on the right lobe; scattered high-intensity circular nodes primarily in the lower-mid quadrant of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous boundary; high-amplitude peaks (8-15 pixels) concentrated at the distal tips; moderate-amplitude peaks (3-6 pixels) distributed along the medial trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature sweeping from the median notch vertex toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast pixel nodes (diameter approx. 4-10 pixels) distributed across the central and lower-medial sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense series of parallel high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe; singular high-intensity linear disruption at a 40-degree angle on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel linear scarring (rake marks) on the left fluke lobe and jagged irregular tip morphology on the far left extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity 'comb' pattern formed by parallel linear markings on the far left distal edge.
